content.title: Is Home Depot Open or Closed on Easter? What to Know for 2026
content.text: Spring has finally arrived and with it comes a variety of home projects. From organizing the garage to yard cleanup, there's no shortage of work to be done this time of year. If your Easter plans include tackling one of the projects above or any other home task, you may be planning to pick up a few necessities this weekend. If that's the case and you're wondering if The Home Depot is open on Easter, you'll find all the details you need to know below.Given that Easter is one of the biggest Christian observances on the calendar, many stores and restaurants are closed in recognition of the April holiday, including popular retailers like Costco, Target and Lowe's. But what about The Home Depot?For the latest details on Home Depot's Easter hours, TODAY.com reached out to the home-improvement retailer for the most up-to-date information on whether or not stores will be open on Sunday, April 5.Since store openings, closings and hours may vary by location, it's a good idea to check local store hours before heading out to any retailer this Easter to ensure you don't find an empty parking lot when you arrive.Whatever you need to get the job done this Easter, you’ll be happy to know that The Home Depot will be open for business on Sunday, April 5.According to a Home Depot spokesperson, stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.To ensure your local Home Depot is open on Sunday, or to confirm store details, use the Home Depot locator, which you'll find right here.Stores Open on Easter 2026Along with The Home Depot, see below for a sampling of stores that will be open on Sunday, April 5, or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Dollar General: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Kroger: A majority of stores will operate during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Trader Joe’s: Stores will be open during regular business hours. Find local hours here.Walmart: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Whole Foods: Stores are open until 6 p.m. Find local hours here.
